facts.fact: The RuPay card given to a PMJDY account holder carries accident insurance cover of Rs 2 lakh for PMJDY accounts opened after 28.8.2018
facts.quote: Accident Insurance Cover of Rs.1 lakh (enhanced to Rs. 2 lakh to new PMJDY accounts opened after 28.8.2018) is available with RuPay card issued to the PMJDY account holders.

facts.fact: For PMJDY accounts opened up to 28.8.2018 the accident cover is Rs 1 lakh
facts.quote: Accident Insurance Cover of Rs.1 lakh (enhanced to Rs. 2 lakh to new PMJDY accounts opened after 28.8.2018) is available with RuPay card issued to the PMJDY account holders.

facts.fact: The RuPay debit card with this accident cover comes free with each PMJDY account (no premium for the cover)
facts.quote: Each account comes with a free RuPay debit card, offering an accident insurance cover of ₹2 lakh, encouraging digital transactions and financial security.
facts.note: 'No premium' is derived from 'free RuPay debit card, offering an accident insurance cover'.

facts.fact: The Rs 30,000 life cover was only for people who opened their first bank account with a RuPay card between 15.08.2014 and 26.01.2015
facts.quote: Person opening Bank account for the first time, with RuPay Card in addition, during the period from 15-08-14 to 26-01-15, or any additional period as may be extended further by Government of India.

facts.fact: The life cover was for the head or an earning member of the family aged 18-59
facts.quote: The person should normally be head of the family or an earning member of the family and should be in the age group of 18 to 59

facts.fact: The Rs 30,000 life cover is a closed legacy benefit: it ran for 5 years, till the end of 2019-20, and new accounts do not get it
facts.quote: The life cover of Rs 30,000/- under the scheme will be initially for a period of 5 years, i.e. till the close of financial year 2019-20.
facts.note: That it is closed for new accounts is derived from the 15.08.2014-26.01.2015 window and the 5-year term; no later extension found on pmjdy.gov.in.

facts.fact: Jan Dhan account holders can also join PMJJBY, a paid scheme: premium Rs 436 a year
facts.quote: The premium payable is Rs.436/- per annum per subscriber.

facts.fact: PMJJBY gives Rs 2 lakh life cover
facts.quote: Rs.2 lakh is payable on a subscriber’s death due to any cause.

facts.fact: PMSBY gives Rs 2 lakh accident cover (on accidental death)
facts.quote: Table of Benefits Sum Insured Death Rs. 2 Lakh

facts.fact: PMSBY premium is Rs 20 a year
facts.quote: Premium payable is Rs.20/- per annum per member.

summary: All confirmed: RuPay accident cover Rs 2 lakh after 28.8.2018 / Rs 1 lakh before (pmjdy.gov.in Scheme page), free card (PIB 27.08.2026), Rs 30,000 life cover only for 15.08.2014-26.01.2015 first accounts, 5 years to 2019-20 (guide.pdf), PMJJBY Rs 436 / PMSBY Rs 20 (DFS).
